pkgmetadata.longdescription: Stirling-PDF is a locally hosted, web-based PDF manipulation tool. This is the official Tauri desktop application built by Stirling PDF Inc, bundling the Stirling-PDF server with an embedded Java runtime.
Stirling-PDF 是一款本地托管的基于 Web 的 PDF 处理工具。本包为 Stirling PDF Inc 官方构建的 Tauri 桌面应用，内置 Stirling-PDF 服务端与嵌入式 Java 运行时。
